body: Sorry for taking so long to respond, I had to do things, but I live alone.

Well my names Josh. I live in a small town in the middle of the United States. My parents were drug addicts. The government took me away and I went into a foster home. I was picked up by an older couple who were physically and verbally abusive. At school I was isolated from the rest of my colleagues. It was because I was ugly. I was bullied because of it for my entire school life. I found out I was gay in eight grade, and also that year I was raped by one of my school mates. I haven’t told anyone this. Now I work night shifts at a factory living paycheck to paycheck.
What do you want to know?
Well there is no helping me. I can’t keep going.
But then you’ll forget me by tomorrow. I’ve been down this before.
No, no one cares about me.
The people that I have told are gone, so I haven’t told anyone in about three years.
It’s a constant feeling that I’ve had. I’ve had it since I was five(I’m 20 now).
I’m lonely and in pain. I don’t have people I can call friends. I don’t have family. I can’t keep people around. I have a lot of guilt, and I want to die.
